tripRule: Trips are as reported in the covering email, which supersedes the workbook derivation.
movementRule: One movement is one transfer between locations: port to rig, rig to port, or rig to rig. Repositioning at the rig already occupied does not count, nor does a shift between two port-side locations.

OD1.lastWeek: M/U 33" clean-out BHA; RIH 33" clean-out BHA and tag FC; drill out 36" shoe track; perform cement job; WOC; drill cement inside 36" casing; injectivity test; drill 33" hole below casing
OD1.nextSteps: Drill 33" hole to 1,000 ft; RIH 30" casing as per tally; conduct cement job as per plan

dataNotes: Trips as IN and OUT. CA1 1 IN / 1 OUT, CA3 2 IN / 2 OUT, CA5 2 IN / 2 OUT, Charlie-3 9 IN / 9 OUT. The OUT figure is used for each vessel. The IN and OUT totals are both 14.
OPH is not shown from this week. It is off hired, and the email no longer reports it.
No bunkering on the Port sheet this week. Every fluid figure is from the Vessel sheet, which records seven fresh water and four drill water bunkerings; the Port sheet's column E has no fluid row.

CA5 water on 02.11: fresh or drill. Vessel E22 says 'received drill water(252M3)', but the sheet records the 252 under fresh water (F22), and its own totals F3 and H3 count it there. The sheet's column is used. If it is drill water, fresh water bunkered is 524 and drill water 1,584; the total is unchanged.
Water written in MT. Charlie-3 'fresh water (20MT)' on 03.11 (Vessel E27) and CA5 'drill wate(195 MT)' on 03.11 (E26). The sheet enters both in its M3 columns (F27, I26), and they are counted as m³.

The Baroid compressor on two days. Port E78 (02.11) and E91 (03.11) both send the Baroid compressor out under RM-SP-9164, and the Truck sheet counts a truck on each day. If it is one truck, OUT is 57 and the total 129.

36" casing to KOC Yard 4: four trucks or eight. On 02.11 Port E70 to E73 send four trucks with 8 joints of 36" casing to KOC Yard 4 (RM-SP-9156 to 9159), and E81 sends four trucks with 8 joints to the pipe yard to deliver to KOC Yard 4 the next day. On 03.11 E94 sends four trucks with 8 joints of 36" casing to KOC Yard 4 (RM-SP-9168 to 9171). The Truck sheet counts both, 8 OUT. If they are the same casing, OUT is 4 lower.

Mud skip trucks on 04.11: six or eight. The email says 6 T8 trucks took 30 full WBM cutting skips to BG-1525. Port E106 and E113 both say 8 trucks, and the Truck sheet counts 8. The sheet's 8 is used.

Casing to berth 20 on 31.10: five trucks or six. Port E39 says 5 trucks brought 39 joints of 24" casing from the pipe yard; E47 says 6 trucks were offloaded with the same 39 joints. The Truck sheet counts 5.

OPH named on two Port rows. E23 (30.10) 'received from OPH (RCM-OP-939)' and E90 (03.11) 'received from OPH as per RCM-OD-975'. OPH is off hired. Both are counted as written; E90's RCM-OD number suggests OD1.
headline: OD1 is drilling the 33" hole at 647 ft with 98% returns. Last week the 36" shoe track was drilled out, a cement job was performed and the 33" hole was drilled below the casing.

dailyOperations.label: Wed 04 Nov 2026
dailyOperations.source: Daily Ground Operations, as circulated in the 05.11.2026 email
lines: Cargo operation with CA3: 26 cargo lifts loaded on CA3, per the updated lookahead received from OD1.
One truck with the RA box from Wireline (call-off OD-SH1R-B-1-9) offloaded, and the box loaded on Charlie-3.
One truck with COSL rig spares and a full acetylene gas cylinder rack (COSL-DT-OD-SH1R-C-4.3) offloaded at Shuaiba berth 20, and loaded on CA3.
One truck loaded with 20 solid cement IBC tanks and sent to Arabian Gulf, Mina Abdullah, for disposal.
Six empty mud skips that arrived from KOC location BG-1525 after disposal of mud cuttings offloaded, and loaded on CA3.
Cargo offloaded from CA5, per RCM-OD-979.
Eight trucks loaded with a total of 30 full mud skips of WBM cuttings, per RM-SP-9180 to 9187, ex RCM-OD-979.
One truck arrived from the Wireline facility with a radioactive source box, per HPM-DT-1643; the RA box was offloaded and loaded on Charlie-3.

One truck loaded with a COSL diverter test plug, a full COSL trash skip (RCM-OD-974 and 976) and a 3 m basket of drill bits, bit breakers and bit gauges, sent to the Shuaiba pipe yard and then to the COSL warehouse, per RM-SP-9178.
One truck arrived at Shuaiba Port with 2 COSL cargo lifts (call-off OD-SH1R-C-4-3).
One truck sent to Arabian Gulf, Mina Abdullah, with 20 IBC tanks of solid cement and mud cuttings for disposal, per RM-SP-9179.
Six T8 trucks dispatched with 30 full WBM cutting skips to the BG-1525 disposal WBM pit.
Trucks arrived at Shuaiba Port with 24 empty mud skips from KOC treatment plant BG-1525, per RDT-SP-9172 to 9177.
